summary: Markdown wire fields carry x-st-text (markdown-block or markdown-inline) in the client-v0 schema, including nullable progress fields; generated TypeScript preserves their opaque Markdown types, literal-text helpers escape entity ampersands, and multiline reference definitions stay in one document

replay.detail: Web UI only; no replay or rebuild.

compatibility.detail: The wire and decoded values are unchanged strings. Forty client-v0 schema fields gain an x-st-text annotation; the generated TypeScript client now types them as opaque MarkdownBlock or MarkdownInline, including nullable fields, so TypeScript consumers read the words through markdownSource. This deliberate source-level contract is not a published client API: @fractal/client, @fractal/sdk, @fractal/views, @fractal/scenarios, fractal-web and apps/ios are all private: true packages in this repository, and the gate typechecks their consumers. Rust and Swift clients are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores plain string types; no stored data changes.
